sv.title: Tydlig nedgång på börsen – alla aktier i OMXS30 sjönk
sv.summary: Stockholmsbörsen avslutade tisdagen i moll efter att den sura stämningen på Wall Street tyngt humöret ytterligare. På bolagsnivå tillhörde bland annat nyrapporterade Nibe dagens förlorare.

en.title: Clear decline on the stock exchange – all shares in OMXS30 fell
en.summary: The Stockholm stock exchange closed Tuesday in the red after the gloomy mood on Wall Street weighed further on sentiment. At company level, recently reported Nibe was among the day's biggest losers.
